title: Finite bases separately for the Picard base-change stalks
statement: Let f:X\to S be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let E be finite locally free [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf], let g:T\to S satisfy PicardUniversalRankMatch f E g [def-sc-picard-universal-rank-match], and let h:T\prime\to T, t\in T\prime, and F=E or F=E^\vee. Write p:X\times_S T\to T and q:X\times_S T\to X for the projections, and p\prime:(X\times_S T)\times_T T\prime\to T\prime and v:(X\times_S T)\times_T T\prime\to X\times_S T for the next two projections [def-pc-base-change]. Put P=h^*p_*q^*F and Q=p\prime_*v^*q^*F, and take their stalks [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] at t. There exist natural numbers r and s and bases over O_{T\prime,t} of P_t and Q_t indexed by Fin r and Fin s respectively. No equality between r and s is asserted.

source.place: local rank reduction, expanded using Tags 01C6 (local frames), 0098 (pullback stalks), and 0097 (composition); agent expansion of the original node argument

proof.text: Apply hR to every h and point. Choose the direct-image rank clause for E or its dual according to hF, forget the rank, and glue finite local freeness using the proved source-library Modules.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_isOpenImmersion. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies tensorPullback with the abstract pullback and transfers its proved preservation of finite local freeness. At the identity h this gives finite local freeness of the original direct image, and then of P after pullback along h. The private rankMatch_directImage_finiteLocallyFree helper gives direct-image local freeness. The final proof applies the existing public SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.of_iso directly to the tensorComparison isomorphism to obtain local freeness of P, using the proved abstract-pullback instance; no separate tensorPullback_finiteLocallyFree theorem is restated.

Use Mathlib pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso to identify the iterated fibre product with X times_S T′. The projection identities and tensor-pullback composition identify the iterated coefficient with pullback along this isomorphism of the coefficient on the single fibre product. Pushforward composition and the invertible unit for pullback/pushforward along a scheme isomorphism give the private iteratedDirectImageIso. Transport the finite local freeness obtained in the first step at h across its inverse to Q.

For either finite locally free module choose a finite frame near t using the proved source-library exists_mem_over_iso_free. Construct coordinate germs by restricting a representative to the intersection with the frame open and applying its coordinate projection. Naturality defines an additive map on the stalk colimit; germ_smul gives its linearity. Coordinate maps of frame germs are Kronecker deltas. Taking germs of the finite projection-inclusion sum gives the spanning identity. These two identities prove a linear equivalence of the stalk with the finite function module. Map Pi.basisFun through its inverse and reindex by Fintype.equivFin. The code adapts the already proved private coordinate-germ construction of FiniteLocallyFreeStalkFinrank; it does not import that theorem or assume any new stalk-basis statement. Apply this private finiteLocallyFree_stalk_basis helper independently to P and Q and combine the two existential witnesses.

lean.statement:
theorem picardRankMatch_baseChange_stalk_finite_bases {X S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] (g : T ⟶ S)
    (hR : PicardUniversalRankMatch f E g) {T' : Scheme.{u}} (h : T' ⟶ T)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : F = E ∨ F = Modules.dual E) (t : T') :
    let P := (Modules.tensorPullback h).obj
      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f g)).obj
        ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F))
    let Q := (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h)).obj
      ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h)).obj
        ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F))
    (∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin r) (T'.presheaf.stalk t)
      (P.presheaf.stalk t))) ∧
    (∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin s) (T'.presheaf.stalk t)
      (Q.presheaf.stalk t)))
